verdict.rationale: Instinct indexes connected data such as email, calendar and Drive, and turns it into AI output delivered in its own messaging and call interface. The privacy policy cites summarizing emails, the homepage claims proactive follow-ups on dropped threads, and testers report email summaries, nudges about forgotten items (including noticing an overdue medical appointment), and context-aware action from the start. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party documentation of an insights or suggestions feature beyond marketing lines, and evidence of insights that are presented as recommendations rather than acted on autonomously.
